title: Active cap bound by runtime scale
statement: Let $n,a,d,B$ be integers with $n>0$, $a>0$, $2a\le d$, and $B\ge1$. Set $\varepsilon=a/d$, $M=\max\{1,\lceil 4B^2/\varepsilon\rceil\}$, $\tau=\varepsilon/(4M)$, and $R=(n+1)(B+1)/\varepsilon$. Then $\lceil4/\tau^2\rceil+1\le 2^{13}R^8$.
hypotheses_covered: The Fourier bound $B$ is an integer at least one
